text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break one day, I spotted Narita Brian
putting up posters in the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Looks like that's finally
about a third of the way done.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: The vice president is going around putting up so many posters all by herself...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
I'll call out and ask if they need a hand.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me!
If it's alright with you――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Eek……!
N-No…… it's nothing……

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What a piercing gaze... Her eyes practically scream
'stay the hell away from me.'

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's go...
Before she gets mad and snaps at us.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah...? What's your deal too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I belong to the student council.
I'm simply doing this as part of my duties.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, pretty much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...More importantly, I have to finish putting up these posters today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If you understand, then move. I don't have time to entertain you.
choice_data_list: Want me to lend a hand?
Looks like this'll build some stamina.
Looks like this'll build some stamina, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If you understand, then move. I don't have time to entertain you.
choice_data_list: Want me to lend a hand?
Looks like this'll build some stamina.
Looks like this'll build some stamina, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Doesn't matter. I'll do it alone.
choice_data_list: Won't it be over in a flash with the two of us?
Won't it be over in a flash with the two of us?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's more trouble to say no. If you want to help that badly, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Clockwise. You'll run counter-clockwise around the academy.
Got it? Don't fall behind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Despite her blunt demeanor, Narita Brian appeared to be handling the student council duties with practiced efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If I think of it as training,
maybe it'll feel a bit more rewarding...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: See you. I will resume my work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian seems to be handling the physically demanding
student council duties with solid proficiency as well.
